design: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: standalone transparent body sprite of the APPROVED nine-year-old angel boy Tenebris for a Unity pixel RPG. Image1 is the approved edit target, with Kiryu-inspired swept-back spiky hairstyle, amber golden eyes, serious protective child's expression, cream/off-white patched rolled-sleeve jacket over a burgundy button shirt, charcoal knee-length cuffed shorts, dark knee socks, worn brown lace-up ankle boots and TWO WHITE feathered wings. Preserve EXACTLY this approved child, facial shape, eye color, head/body proportions, clothing, patch, stitching, wing shapes, standing posture and rendering. ONLY TWO changes: recolor ALL scalp hair from white to true BLACK (charcoal highlights, no white/gray locks), keeping identical swept-back spiky hairstyle; REMOVE the detached golden halo above his head completely, including residual glow, since it will be a separate layer. Keep his eyebrows dark black. Compact child legs; no adult musculature. Crisp detailed shaded pixel/chibi game artwork, subtle fabric and feather volume matching the reference. One full body entirely contained with generous true-transparent margins. No halo, no weapon, no staff, no ground shadow, no scenery, no lettering. Do not change the jacket to suspenders, do not add bows or jewelry, do not redesign the character. Actual RGBA transparent background.
halo: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE separate original etheric angel halo sprite for Tenebris in a pixel RPG. Subject: a very thin COMPLETE closed shallow horizontal ellipse of neutral pearl-white light, with a delicate concentric inner ellipse; one tiny hollow diamond centered on the near/front rim, and two very short fine luminous parallel bars symmetrically inset near the far/back rim. Quiet protective geometric motif, distinct from a jewelry ring. No feathers, no wing-shaped fins, no side protrusions. Symmetric horizontally for exact lateral mirroring. This is ethereal light: partially transparent slender strokes with a slight soft edge, no metallic shading, no solid thick band, no broad bloom. Transparent gap between rings, transparent open center and transparent exterior. Neutral grayscale ONLY so it can be recolored. Readable compact silhouette at 96pixels width; no background, no other objects, no text, no character. Center the ONE complete halo in an ample truly transparent RGBA canvas. Original geometry, not an existing franchise emblem; same shape retained into adulthood.

animations.right:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: production pixel-art animation spritesheet for the approved nine-year-old angel BOY Tenebris in a Unity classic top-down RPG. Image1 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY reference: preserve short swept-back spiky BLACK hair with charcoal highlights (never white), amber GOLDEN eyes, child's serious protective expression, fair skin, cream/off-white patched jacket with rolled sleeves over a burgundy button shirt, charcoal knee-length cuffed shorts, dark knee socks, worn brown lace-up ankle boots, TWO WHITE feathered wings. Compact sturdy CHILD body, short proportional thighs/shins, same shoe size in every frame. NO HALO baked into frames: separate layer. No weapons. Image2 is Alice's APPROVED ANIMATION sheet for STYLE, SCALE and MOTION RHYTHM only. Copy her gentle four-phase leg timing and small child strides, but draw the BOY from image1, NEVER Alice, no dress, no blue bows. Match Alice's crisp detailed shaded pixel-game artwork and readable small-scale face, fabric and feather volume.
Layout: ONE true-transparent landscape spritesheet, exactly FOUR evenly spaced COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, uniform4x3grid. Prefer2048x1536 cells512x512. Row1 WALK=4drawings; row2 RUN=4drawings; row3 IDLE BREATHING=3drawings in first3cells, fourthcell entirelyEMPTY transparent. Eleven full bodies only. Each entire head, both wings and both feet contained within its own cell, with ample transparent padding and wide clear gutters. No overlap/cutoff, no checkerboard/solid backdrop, no ground shadows, no labels/numbers/grid lines. Uniform body/head size, same perspective, same clothes, stable crown and pelvis registration in each row.
Movement left to right: 1CONTACT A, one foot forward and opposite behind; 2PASS A, feet close together, advancing knee gently bends; 3CONTACT B, the OPPOSITE foot forward; 4PASS B, feet close together passing other way. Loop4to1 with modest evenly progressing pose differences. Visible alternation of legs, no repeating the same foot-forward silhouette. Walk moderate short steps; run slightly wider compact stride, subtle bent-elbow counter-swing, no exaggerated split/leap, no stretched limbs. Wings trail softly with tiny secondary sway, no wing flapping; hair stable. All four frames same leg lengths, boot sizes and head scale.
Idle row: feet planted in SAME relaxed standing pose in all3frames, both arms loosely down; only slight chest/jacket breathing (relaxed,tiny inhale,tiny exhale), no walking legs, no hopping, no large head turns.
Direction: every frame faces screen-RIGHT in consistent three-quarter SIDE view, suitable for moving right on a top-down map. White wings trail behind on screen-left. Match exact side-view camera and gentle leg sequence of image2. No front/back-facing frames.
